title: isodon latiflorus
intro: Isodon latiflorus, commonly known as Chinese sage, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. It is traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Isodon latiflorus include reducing fever, relieving cough and asthma symptoms, and promoting digestion, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as diterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. These bioactive compounds are responsible for the plant's pharmacological effects, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial actions.
